comment: Frozen storage-slot vectors for the v1.1 entry-ring layout (conventions §3 table, placement §2). placement_key_hex is uvarint(len(database)) || database || uvarint(len(bucket)) || bucket || encid_hex, where encid_hex is EncodeComponent(_id_). slot is uint16(xxhash64(placement key) >> 51), 13 bits. The rows were computed from the spec's byte layout, not from the code under test; a changed row moves every document it covers. The two last rows break a missing length prefix.
